primitive.meaning: resolve for a provider outcome; invalid when intake or state I/O raised.

changed.meaning: Whether the new resolution record differs from the previous record.

detail.meaning: Provider or timezone-validation error text on a failed lookup.

state.meaning: Published subset of the household clock document, possibly empty. It can contain schema_version, timezone, observed_at, valid_until, provider, validation_status, applied_timezone, pending_timezone and pending_observed_at. State reads preserve the stored values.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: Literal outcomes emitted by the stop and its envelope reader. The envelope reader can also emit missing envelope kernel keys: followed by the comma-joined missing keys. Unnormalized exception text can also be returned; those values are not a finite enum.
